# English is Easy

> > English is Easy is a comprehensive Russian-language platform for ОГЭ (Russian State Exam) English preparation, featuring practice tasks for listening, grammar, reading, and speaking sections.

The site provides detailed exam tasks aligned with ФИПИ standards, covering grammar transformations (Present Perfect, Past Simple), listening comprehension exercises, reading tasks featuring historical figures like Leonardo da Vinci and Catherine II, and speaking assignments. All content is designed for Russian students preparing for the ОГЭ English examination.

## Key Topics

- ОГЭ (Russian State Exam)
- ФИПИ standards
- Listening comprehension
- Grammar transformations
- Present Perfect
- Past Simple
- Word formation
- Speaking tasks
- Reading comprehension
- Verb transformations
- Interview analysis
- Pronunciation assessment
- Exam preparation strategies
- Audio comprehension
- Monologue tasks
